sections.label: Naming stillborn children
sections.summary: Clause 9 introduces new RBDA sections letting parents apply to the Registrar-General to enter a name in the stillbirth register within one year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: First, clause 9 of the Bill will introduce new sections in RBDA to allow for the official naming of a stillborn child.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The new section 36A will enable the parents of a stillborn child to apply to the Registrar-General of Births and Deaths, or RG for short, for a name to be entered in the stillbirth register within one year after the stillbirth, should they wish to do so.

sections.label: Stillbirth definition threshold raised
sections.summary: Clause 2 amends the definition by raising the threshold from 22 weeks of pregnancy to 24 weeks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Clause 2 of the Bill amends the definition by raising the threshold from 22 weeks of pregnancy to 24 weeks.

sections.label: MOH reviews on viability
sections.summary: MOH reviews in 2018 and 2022 with local experts found survival at 22 weeks close to zero and foetal viability at 24 weeks about 50%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Reviews by the Ministry of Health (MOH) in 2018 and 2022 involving local experts concluded that the survival rate for premature babies born at 22 weeks is close to zero, while foetal viability at 24 weeks is about 50%.

sections.label: Threshold aligned with abortion cut-off
sections.summary: MHA and MOH will amend the stillborn child definition to 24 weeks, aligning with the Termination of Pregnancy Act and removing confusion; clauses 10 and 11 amend the Income Tax Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: MHA has reviewed the matter with MOH and will amend the threshold in the definition of "stillborn child" in RBDA to 24 weeks of pregnancy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This will align with the cut-off for abortions in the Termination of Pregnancy Act 1974 and remove any potential confusion regarding foetal viability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Clauses 10 and 11 of the Bill make similar amendments to the definition of "stillborn child" in the Income Tax Act 1947.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Stillborn children are counted in the child order for the purposes of administering tax benefits.

sections.label: Support for naming stillbirth babies
sections.summary: The Deputy Speaker is told there are strong reasons to support the Bill allowing bereaved parents to name stillbirth babies carried more than 24 weeks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Deputy Speaker, Sir, there are strong reasons to support the Bill to allow bereaved parents to name stillbirth babies, whom they had carried for more than 24 weeks.

sections.label: Wrongful death claim consideration
sections.summary: One consideration for parents after a stillbirth is the availability of a wrongful death claim.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: One consideration for parents after a stillbirth is the availability of a wrongful death claim.

sections.label: Mandatory insurance for stillbirth autopsies
sections.summary: The Ministry may consider mandatory insurance coverage for autopsies after stillbirth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Next, the Ministry may consider mandatory insurance coverage for autopsies after stillbirth.

sections.label: Tax benefit for stillbirth costs
sections.summary: A tax benefit could be considered to help parents with stillbirth costs, especially lower socioeconomic status mothers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Lastly, a tax benefit could be considered to provide practical assistance and support to the parents for the surprising costs of stillbirth, especially helpful for the mothers with lower socioeconomic status.

sections.label: Aligning stillborn child thresholds
sections.summary: The amendments align stillborn child thresholds, with the existing Act at 22 weeks, altered from 28 weeks in the 1937 Act.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The amendments align the thresholds for what would constitute a stillborn child: the existing Registration of Births and Deaths Act currently sets the threshold at 22 weeks, which was, in turn, an alteration of the original 28 weeks in the original 1937 Act.

sections.label: Survival at 25 weeks and registration
sections.summary: WHO report and evidence suggest most live-born babies survive from 25 weeks, and the Bill does not clarify name registration applies regardless of nationality.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, the same WHO report as well as the extant scientific evidence, suggests that, in high-income countries, such as ours, most live-born babies will survive even when they are born as early as 25 weeks of gestation, which is closer to the proposed 24-week threshold.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The Bill, with accompanying collaterals, also does not make clear that the ability to register names for stillborn children applies to all children born in Singapore, regardless of nationality.

sections.label: Rationale for 24-week threshold
sections.summary: Minister of State Sun Xueling shared the rationale for increasing the threshold from 22nd to 24th week is medical community feedback on misinterpretation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Minister of State Sun Xueling had earlier shared the rationale provided for increasing the threshold from the 22nd to 24th week of pregnancy is to address feedback from the medical community on potential misinterpretation of the threshold.

sections.label: Steps on foetal viability information
sections.summary: The question asks if the Government is looking into other steps to ensure parents have proper information on foetal viability outside the womb.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: If there is, in fact, a significant risk of confusion about foetal viability, beyond increasing the threshold, can the Minister of State share if the Government is looking into other steps to ensure that parents have proper information relevant to foetal viability outside the womb?

sections.label: Commemorative birth certificate applications
sections.summary: MHA clarified parents may apply for a commemorative birth certificate pending new provisions being operationalised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: MHA has clarified that pending the new provisions being operationalised, parents who wish to name their stillborn child may apply for a commemorative birth certificate.

sections.label: Naming stillborn children
sections.summary: Under new section 36A of the RBDA, parents may apply to name a stillborn child within a year after the stillbirth.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Under the new section 36A of the RBDA, parents with stillbirths registered in Singapore may apply for their stillborn child to be officially named when the provisions are operationalised, as long as the application to name the child is made within a year after the stillbirth.

sections.label: Tortious claims for stillbirths
sections.summary: Amendments do not affect existing legal rights or claims, including tortious claims, a mother may have over her stillborn child.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Mr Gan Thiam Poh asked about tortious claims and expressed concern that a mother should not be deprived of an opportunity to file a wrongful death claim if the stillbirth was due to tortious conduct.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We would like to assure the Member that these amendments are not intended to and do not affect any existing legal rights or claims, including tortious claims, that a mother may have in relation to her stillborn child.

sections.label: Commemorative certificates issued
sections.summary: 51 commemorative birth certificates have been issued, and parents have asked for overnight issuance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: To date, 51 commemorative birth certificates have been issued and like I mentioned, there have been parents who have reached out over email, over the phone, to ask for overnight issuance of commemorative birth certificates.
